notes.text: The linked Gemara gives Rabbi Tachlifa son of Rav Chisda speaking in Rav Chisda’s name about the south wind. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3549&lang=en) records the same transmission and titles Tachlifa Rav.
